snippet.title: Arkheron Returns for Next Fest and Closed Beta
snippet.description:
Welcome back to the Tower. This Road Ahead video lays out what’s next for Arkheron: the Steam NextFest open demo, details on update 0.16.0, planning for Closed Beta, and more.

From February 20 to March 2, Arkheron will be playable 24/7 as a Steam NextFest demo. No key required.

For the full breakdown, read the Road Ahead blog here: https://www.arkheron.com/news/road-ahead-feb-2026

Wishlist now: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333850/Arkheron/ 
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/arkheron/9PF4B4MD1QZC/0010
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016490 

Follow us:
Discord: http://discord.gg/arkheron
